title: Finance for India-GCC Groups and Cross-Border Businesses
menuText: One team and one set of numbers across the Gulf
summary: One monthly cycle across India and the UAE or Saudi Arabia, with consolidated reporting in INR and AED or SAR.
metaTitle: India-GCC Group Accounting, Tax and Reporting
metaDescription: Consolidated MIS, intercompany tracking, Ind AS to IFRS reporting and local compliance for Indian businesses with GCC operations and Gulf owners with Indian companies.
heroHeading: One team on both sides of the Gulf.
heroIntro: For businesses with operations, owners or investors in both India and the GCC, we run the finance function across both, so your group numbers always reconcile.

challenges.title: Separate books and advisers
challenges.text: Different advisers, different calendars and different definitions in each country.

challenges.title: Framework and currency differences
challenges.text: Indian GAAP or Ind AS on one side, IFRS on the other, in more than one currency.

challenges.title: Cross-border filings
challenges.text: Remittances, intercompany loans and FEMA-related data that need careful documentation.

howWeHelp.title: Indian business with GCC operations
howWeHelp.text: Consolidated MIS in INR and in AED or SAR, Indian GAAP or Ind AS to IFRS reconciliation, intercompany tracking, and parent-company reporting for foreign subsidiaries.

howWeHelp.title: Gulf-based owner with an Indian business
howWeHelp.text: Monthly reporting for the Indian entity in AED or SAR, with GST, TDS, income tax and payroll handled for you and dashboards you can read from the Gulf.

planHeading: Usually a core subscription in each country, plus consolidation
planText: Core subscription in each country, plus consolidation. Gulf-based owners typically take a core subscription in India with GCC-currency reporting.

faqs.a: We prepare the data for FEMA-related filings such as the annual FLA return. Certifications are provided by your independent CA.

faqs.q: Can we see one dashboard across both countries?
faqs.a: Yes. Consolidated dashboards can show both entities in INR and in AED or SAR.
